magic.typemoonaddon.imaginary_absorption: An evolved Imaginary formula born from assimilating a Crest Worm. It absorbs held items, dropped items and blocks into Imaginary Space. Living targets must remain under the crosshair or absorption ends. While maintained, it applies Weakness III, deals 30 health damage and transfers up to 30 mana each second without immobilizing the target. Absorption remains usable while Protection is active. After the Grail ritual, it deals 10x damage to Servant targets.
magic.typemoonworld.typemoonaddon:imagin:
An evolved Imaginary formula.
Absorb items and blocks into Imaginary Space, or keep a living target under the crosshair to weaken it with Weakness III while absorbing its health and mana. Losing the target ends absorption; the target remains mobile.
Absorption remains available while Protection is active.
magic.typemoonaddon.imaginary_storage.de: A basic Imaginary Magic formula. Use Type Moon World's magic-mode key to choose Storage or Protection, then use the native cast key. Storage sends a held item or targeted item entity to Imaginary Space. Protection nullifies ordinary damage and erases incoming formulas inside a 2x2x2 area.
magic.typemoonworld.typemoonaddon:imagin:
A basic Imaginary Magic formula.
Use the native magic-mode key to choose storage or protection, then cast to apply it.
Protection has a 2,000-point shield and becomes a permanent toggle after the Holy Grail Fragment ritual.

magic.typemoonaddon.summon_black_mud.des: Use the magic-mode key to choose Release or Dismiss. Release can summon black-and-red mud at multiple locations; Dismiss clears every pool you released, and death dismisses them automatically. Creatures touching it receive Slowness VI, continuously lose mana, and accumulate Pollution faster; combining it with Shadow Binding fully immobilizes them. Grail-ascended players and their summons are immune.

magic.typemoonaddon.forbidden_magic.name: Forbidden Magic
magic.typemoonaddon.forbidden_magic.desc: Requires at least 900 mana. Casting causes Nausea for 10 seconds and halves mana regeneration during that time. Clouds pierce the invader and swallow them into the sea of shadows beyond the plane; a vortex of darkness that easily banishes beings of the hidden world and binds an opponent through invisible uncertainty, the nature of Imaginary Magic.
magic.typemoonworld.typemoonaddon:forbid: Requires at least 900 mana. After completing the incantation, connect Imaginary Absorption to every creature and player in a 120-degree cone within a spherical radius of 50 blocks for two seconds, consuming all mana. Casting causes Nausea for 10 seconds and halves mana regeneration during that time.
